rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"medium","title":"Ignored-field flag update changed from |= to &=","detail":"In the field loop of GetObjectInfo, the update for [IgnoreMember] fields changed from |= to &=, and the requirement does not ask for this. The flag starts as false, so a non-public ignored field can no longer set it. A public ignored field now clears it, even after an earlier non-public keyed member set it to true. The property branch at line 899 still uses |=, so properties and fields now behave differently. Clearing the flag skips the deferred non-public diagnostics, MessagePackObjectAllowPrivateRequired (line 1352) and the PartialTypeRequired check (line 1382). The generator could then emit a nested formatter into a non-partial type that has private keyed members, and the generated code would not compile.
